question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3–5 business days. Delivery times may vary by destination.

question: Can I return an item?
answer: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Contact support with your order number to start a return.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. If you cannot find it, contact support with your order number.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards. Your payment options are shown at checkout.

question: How can I contact a human support agent?
answer: Email support@example.com with your order number and a short description of the issue. A support agent will follow up.
